title: Add cookie prompt to angular.io
body:
1) Create a cookie pop up for the site (in the style of https://web.dev)
2) Add the following text
"This site uses cookies from Google to deliver its services and to analyze traffic.
  Learn more.    Ok, Got it." 
Notes: 
Clicking the “Ok, Got it” button should dismiss the cookie bar. Clicking the “Ok, Got it” button should be recorded on the client (either local storage or cookie) so that we can remember the user’s choice and the user does not see the cookie bar again unless they have cleared their cookies.
Note: there is no option to decline - only to "[Learn More](https://policies.google.com/technologies/cookies)" or click "Ok, Got it."
author: Participant 1

comments.body: When you say in the style of web.dev, do you mean their general banner: As far as I can tell web.dev does not have a cookie banner for the purposes described here. Regarding our implementation, we already have banner infrastructure, which we can reuse quite easily I believe.
